clarified_intent.description: Refine the core DevTools README, security-boundary note, public export ledger, and packed acceptance report into a truthful archive-readiness packet.

constraints: Public root and ./devtools entry points must be distinguished exactly.
Metadata-only defaults, explicit value inclusion, redaction failure, limits, and transport ownership must match production code.
Every acceptance claim must trace to the retained assembled packed-consumer report.
The packet must not claim that the React inspector, Chrome extension, Flutter tooling, entity inspection, or controller-owned time travel is complete.

target_state.description: A concise package guide and evidence packet that can survive artifact-only review without unsupported DevTools product claims.
success_criteria: README examples use only exported symbols and the documented package subpath.
Security notes identify concrete data, client, store, lifecycle, and transport boundaries.
The export ledger contains separate root and ./devtools entries.
The acceptance report records pass status for both package consumers and every required scenario.

unknowns: The later entity-inspection and time-travel changes may revise the protocol; this packet certifies only the current core observability change.
